rules.statement: The defendant can raise the defense of exceptio doli against a fraudulent transaction, even if the transferor is not made a party to the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "It may be raised against all persons who have acted in a fraudulent manner. There is therefore no substance in Mr. Weerasooria�s contention that the defendant cannot succeed in this action unless Podinona is joined as a party and a claim is made for the setting aside of P2."
